title: UI风格#123 - Minimalist Japanese (极简日式)
description: 创建第123种UI风格：极简日式风格 - 侘寂美学、大量留白、木质纹理。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDS.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Minimalist Japanese style When color palette Then features washi white, sumi black, matcha green, clay beige
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#FAF8F5 (和纸白), #1A1A1A (墨黑), #8B7355 (抹茶绿), #D4B896 (黏 土), #4A4A4A (石灰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Minimalist Japanese style When typography Then uses japanese minimal: Zen Kaku Gothic New, Noto Sans JP, or Shippori Mincho
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Zen Kaku Gothic New (标题), Noto Sans JP (正文), Shippori Mincho (装饰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Minimalist Japanese style When layout Then asymmetric balance, centered composition, generous margins, tatami grid
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：非对称平衡、居中构图、宽大边距、榻榻米网格

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Minimalist Japanese style When UI elements Then washi texture, enso circles, bamboo accents, paper fold
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：和纸质感、圆相圈、竹节点缀、纸张折叠

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Minimalist Japanese UI When functional Then includes zen chat, artisan agents, harmony stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：禅意聊天、工匠代理、和谐统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Minimalist Japanese UI When copy Then uses wabi-sabi: 'Wabi', 'Sabi', 'Ma', 'Mono no aware'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'WABI. SABI. MA.'、按钮'SEND'→'CONTEMPLATE'、'SUBMIT'→'HARMONIZE'
